facts.fact: 湖另一侧有个隐蔽的石滩空地——两英里半坑洼土路的尽头，是他的坟墓级秘密。
facts.anchor: this place is a secret I could take to my grave.

facts.fact: 几个月前他帮 Everett 在湖边给 Ruth 布置过惊喜野餐；今天他是独行侠攒了寒酸版。
facts.anchor: A few months ago, I helped Everett set up a surprise picnic for Ruth on the banks of this lake.

facts.fact: 接头暗号：香槟生蚝在此夫人——她假嗲拒绝：我过敏。
facts.anchor: I got your champagne and oysters right here, m’lady.

facts.fact: 他根本不爱吃生蚝——就算爱也不会让它靠近她。
facts.anchor: I don’t even like oysters. And even if I did, I wouldn’t have ‘em brought anywhere near you.

facts.fact: 她的黑色玩笑：爸爸不是你最该怕的——Ev 会先撕了你喂你吃回去。
facts.anchor: “Daddy ain’t the least of your worries. Ev would tear your balls off and feed ‘em to you first.”

facts.fact: 十年级时同学全家死于酒驾迎头相撞——他今晚带两瓶香槟却一口不喝。
facts.anchor: Ev, Jody, and I lost a classmate and his entire family to a drunk-driving accident when we were in tenth grade.

facts.fact: 零食盒 charcuterie 上桌，她直奔金鱼饼干——如他所料。
facts.anchor: She goes straight for the Goldfish crackers, exactly as I knew she would.

facts.fact: 关系谈判：她要他直视眼睛说「我们只是炮友」——「该你来问我，而我可能答应」。
facts.anchor: “No, you’re gonna ask me. And I might say yes.”

facts.fact: 挠痒痒逼供出的 Yes 尖叫。
facts.anchor: “Yes!” She squeals. “Oh my god, please stop. I’m gonna pee.”

facts.fact: 他整手包住她的手腕举过头顶、吻住她脸上的笑——她唇上的香槟味完美。
facts.anchor: There’s something so damn perfect about the taste of champagne on her lips.

facts.fact: 他从不是抱抱型——过去所有投入都通向性；与她在一起他能做自己。
他想抚平灵魂里破烂的、不认识爱的角落。
facts.anchor: soothe the parts of my soul that are ragged, that don’t recognize love

facts.fact: 天文课：北斗是大熊的屁股、永远指向北极星——跟着北极星就到家，或者说，到你的心。
facts.anchor: Follow the North Star to take you home. Or your heart.

facts.fact: 她说从没在日落时来过这里——很美。
facts.anchor: “I don’t think I’ve ever been here at sunset.

facts.fact: 她的 North Star 名单翻译成 Family；他吻她发顶。
facts.anchor: “My heart,” she agrees. I kiss the top of her head. My heart might just be with her.
